story.title: AI Helped Improve Water Resilience and Community Development in Rajasthan's Last-Mile Villages
story.summary: A community development project in two Rajasthan districts used a lightweight AI application to strengthen water resilience and improve last-mile responsiveness among frontline government workers. The AI tool was designed to sit within existing large government programmes, enhancing local coordination and behaviour change without requiring heavy infrastructure. The project demonstrated that AI does not need to be large-scale or expensive to deliver meaningful impact in rural India.
use_cases: frontline worker support in rural India
